notes: What video-calls needs from the application component that provides the configuration. The service address and key references are collected settings (see interfaces/contract.json settings); the rest are arguments and callbacks.

fields.roomPrefix: string including its separator, equal to the room service's roomPrefix; argument of videoGrant and listRooms
fields.participant: authenticated participant identity (playerId and name) for videoGrant; publish is false for spectators and no grant is issued for a display
fields.canCapture: ()=>boolean, Video option; false on a shared display
fields.modeEvent: string, Video option: the browser event name display-mode publishes
fields.environment: videoEnvironment(settings, secrets) result, or LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET from the server environment
